defs.def: a statue, stone, etc. that is built in order to remind people of an important past event or of a famous person who has died 纪念碑（或像等）

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 华盛顿首都纪念碑自行车之旅

ex.s: Knowledgeable guides will entertain you with the most, interesting stories about Presidents, Congress, memorials, and parks.
ex.t: 导游服务包括自行车、头盔、饼干和瓶装水。

ex.s: Get up close to the monuments and memorials as your bike the sites of Capitol Hill and the National Mall.
ex.t: 当你骑行经过国会山和国家广场的景点时，可以近距离观赏那些纪念碑和纪念建筑。

defs.def: a thing that will continue to remind people of sb/sth 纪念物；纪念品

ex.s: Seventy years later, men who had fought on D-Day gathered on both sides of the English Channel, where people were coming together for memorial ceremonies.
ex.t: 七十年后，曾在诺曼底登陆日作战的人们聚集在英吉利海峡两岸，人们聚集在那里举行纪念仪式。

ex.s: Tourists have used paint, rocks, or even keys to write on the Luxor Temple in Egypt, the Colosseum in Rome, Stonehenge in the UK, memorial stones at the bottom of Qomolangma, and many, many other places.
ex.t: 游客们用颜料、石头甚至钥匙在埃及的卢克索神庙、罗马的斗兽场、英国的巨石阵、珠峰脚下的纪念碑以及许多许多其他地方涂写。

ex.s: C to build a memorial to the heroes who saved their lives.
ex.t: 要为拯救了他们生命的英雄们建造一座纪念碑。

ex.s: While in exile in 1045, Fan wrote an essay entitled Memorial to Yueyang Tower.
ex.t: 1045年流放期间，范仲淹写了一篇题为《岳阳楼记》的文章。

ex.s: Fan wrote the essay Memorial to Yueyang Tower.
